name: Carnival of Chaos

specialRules.name: Dangerous to Know
specialRules.text: A Carnival of Chaos may never hire any type of Hired Sword.

specialRules.name: Maximum Characteristics
specialRules.text: All members except Plague Bearers and Nurglings (which never gain experience) use the maximum characteristics for Humans.

equipmentLists.name: Blessings of Nurgle
equipmentLists.usedBy: Tainted Ones (only when recruited; one or more Blessings, first at listed price, second and subsequent cost double)

items.name: Stream of Corruption
items.note: Shooting attack, range 6", Strength 3, no armour saves.

items.name: Nurgle's Rot
items.note: Immune to all poisons. If this model makes a successful to-hit roll of natural 12 in hand-to-hand, the target contracts Nurgle's Rot (living models only). Before each battle the infected warrior must pass a Toughness test or lose 1 Toughness permanently (dies at 0). If a natural 12 is rolled on that Toughness test, the Rot passes to a random other warband member.

items.name: Cloud of Flies
items.note: Close combat opponent suffers -1 to hit on all attacks.

items.name: Mark of Nurgle
items.note: +1 Wound and immune to all poisons.

items.name: Plague Cart
items.note: 0-1. Profiles (M WS BS S T W I A Ld): Cart - - - - 8 4 - - -; Wheel - - - - 6 1 - - -; Horse 8 - - 3 3 1 3 - -; Guardian - 3 - 3 3 - 3 1 -. Warband maximum increased by +2. Plague Bearers and Nurglings may re-roll Leadership tests for Instability and add +1 to Injury rolls when taken out of action. Guardian (Strength 3 attacks cause Nurgle's Rot) cannot dismount or leave the cart, cannot be injured unless the Cart is destroyed (then he is too), is Daemonic (never gains experience), uses no weapons or armour. Cart and Guardian are immune to psychology and automatically pass Leadership tests.

fighters.name: Carnival Master

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any models in the warband within 6" of the Master may use his Leadership instead of their own.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.text: The Master is a wizard and uses Nurgle Rituals.

fighters.notes: Warband must have exactly one Master.

specialRules.name: Unnatural Strength
specialRules.text: Brutes start the game with the Strongman skill from the Strength skill list.

fighters.name: Tainted One

specialRules.name: Nurgle's Blessings
specialRules.text: Tainted Ones must start the game with one or more Blessings of Nurgle (cost added to the hire price; second and later Blessings cost double; cannot be bought after recruitment).

fighters.notes: Hire cost is 25 gc plus the cost of Blessings of Nurgle.

conversionNotes: Daemonic Instability: D6 roll of 1-3 -> D12 roll of 1-6 (proportional; the schema table has no 1-3 entry).
Daemonic Aura: 5+ armour save -> 9+ per the 5+ -> 9+ rule.
Nurgle's Rot: 'roll of 6' to hit and 'a 6 on the Toughness test' -> natural 12.
Nurgle Rituals (Daemonic Vigour 5+ -> 4+ aura improvement, Scabrous Hide 2+ save, etc.) are spell text not captured in this schema; the spell list needs separate conversion.
Stream of Corruption and Pestilence are Strength 3 hits; S was not doubled here (app doubles characteristics, not weapon/attack strengths) - human should check.
Plague Cart is printed as a 0-1 hire entry with its own profiles but is stored as a misc equipment item with profiles in the note.
Blessings of Nurgle are stored as a misc equipment list for Tainted Ones; hire cost 25 gc + blessings.
Brutes are restricted to the Brute equipment list (Double-handed weapon, Flail); no armour access.
Skill tables read from the printed check table: Master all five, Brutes Combat/Strength/Speed, Tainted Ones Combat/Speed.
Item names were put in sentence case (Light armour, Morning star).
